description: Starts watching a competitor. Pass `input` (the business name as the owner said it is enough: it is first looked up on the web for its exact name, site and Facebook page, then in the ad libraries; a site or a Facebook page link also works). One clear match is added at once; several come back as candidates (name, site, Facebook page, live ads), and the chosen one is confirmed with `candidateId`. A name that looks like a competitor already in the list (or one Taseli suggested) is NOT added: the reply says which one, so ask the owner to confirm; for a different business call again with addAnyway true. For "replace X with Y" use `replace` (one call). A business with no live ads can still be followed. A competitor Taseli suggested is confirmed by passing its id as `candidateId`. Its ads appear within minutes on the Competitors page, under its card. Owner, admin or manager only; up to the plan's limit (3 or 6); 40 searches a day. Changes no ad account and spends no ad money.

addAnyway.description: Only after the owner confirmed that `input` is a different business than the similar one already in the list.

candidateId.description: A candidate id from an earlier reply of this tool, or a suggested competitor's id.

input.description: Facebook page link, website/domain, or business name, e.g. 'leos.co.il'.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

replace.description: Swap instead of add: a followed competitor's name or id to stop following, while `input`/`candidateId` is the one to follow in its place. One operation ("replace X with Y"); if the new one can't be added, X stays.

name: add_competitor

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Follow a competitor
